policy.cue: Disabled. Inspect up to six ranked initial results under the same seven-call ceiling.
policy.reads: Ranked returned files/anchors only; center requested61-line window on the shown interval. File-only results begin at line1. Skip fully covered read intervals, clipped at EOF only when a previous read reported it.
policy.feedback: None. Returned/inspected does not imply usefulness or acceptance.
policy.stopping: Fixed schedule/limits only. Never use annotation overlap or success to stop.

timing_competition: Core compilation finished before the sequential pipeline; no competing benchmark/training is started.
